title: CNA Assignment Sheet Shift Handoff
brief: A structured, prioritized task list for two Certified Nursing Assistants covering the evening shift on Oak Wing.

delegate.scenario: You are the charge LPN on Oak Wing at Meadowview Rehabilitation Center organizing duties for the 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM shift. Two CNAs need a clear allocation of resident care tasks, vitals schedules, and dining duties before change-of-shift report at 3:15 PM. You need an organized assignment sheet that balances the workload and ensures safety protocols are maintained.
delegate.inputs:
Oak Wing Census & Orders (03/24/2026):
- Room 201 (J. Ellison): Total care, turn q2h, strict NPO except ice chips per speech therapy. Vitals TID.
- Room 202 (M. Gable): Stand-by assist x1, blood glucose checks AC/HS. Normal diet.
- Room 203 (D. Chen): Fall risk, bed alarm on at all times, assist x2 with pivot transfers. Weight check weekly on Mondays.
- Room 204 (R. Torres): Independent with walker. Vitals q-shift. Needs vitals taken before physical therapy at 3:30 PM.

CNA assignments:
- CNA Jackson: Rooms 201-202. Dining room monitor at 5:00 PM dinner.
- CNA Rivera: Rooms 203-204. Break relief at 7:00 PM.

Notes from Day Shift:
- Ellison ice chips tolerated well. Order update from Dr. Patel: Ellison diet advanced to pureed with honey-thick liquids at lunch today.
- Chen weighed this morning: 164 lbs. Last Monday was 152 lbs. Chen also refusing transfer assist x2, insists family helps alone.
- Evening vitals due: Ellison, Gable, Torres. Torres vitals logged at 15:45.
delegate.goal: Provide a clear, safe, and balanced duty list for both CNAs that prioritizes immediate care needs and clarifies conflicting dietary and care instructions.

criteria.text: Specifies that the output is an assignment sheet intended for evening shift CNAs Jackson and Rivera.
Formats the output into a clear, room-by-room breakdown or per-aide checklist with distinct timing blocks.
Constrains the tone to be direct, concise, and focused strictly on aide scope of practice tasks.
Instructs the assistant to flag dietary contradictions or inconsistent care orders against clinical documentation.
Requires verification of scheduled timing for critical patient vitals and procedures to catch timing discrepancies.

traps.description: Room 201 (Ellison) has conflicting diet orders: strict NPO except ice chips in the primary census versus advanced pureed with honey-thick liquids in the day shift notes.
Room 204 (Torres) requires vitals before physical therapy at 3:30 PM, but the shift notes record vitals logged at 15:45 (after therapy start).
